article.title: Gemini加入檔案預覽與直接編輯，PDF支援網頁及手機
article.title_en: Gemini adds in-chat file preview and editing, with PDFs on web and mobile
article.summary: Google於10月29日公布Gemini檔案製作、預覽與直接編輯功能；PDF預覽及編輯支援網頁和手機，其他列明格式只支援網頁。
article.summary_en: Google announced file creation, preview and direct editing in Gemini on October 29. PDF preview and editing support web and mobile; other listed formats are web-only.
article.why: 行銷團隊可評估在同一對話完成初稿與修改，仍須檢查匯出後的版面及數字。
article.why_en: Marketing teams can assess drafting and revision in one conversation while checking exported layouts and numbers.
article.next_step: 用一份非機密簡報及PDF測試修改流程，對照原始文案、表格及手機預覽。
article.next_step_en: Test a nonconfidential deck and PDF, comparing original copy, tables and the mobile preview.
highlights: 其他格式包括Google Docs、Google Sheets、簡報、Markdown、TXT及程式碼。
Google表示功能向Gemini App可用地區及語言的所有用戶開放；可自行修改或選取內容要求AI調整。
highlights_en: Other formats include Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown, TXT and code.
Google says the capabilities are available to all users in languages where Gemini is available; users can edit directly or select content for AI refinement.
article.detail:
Google於10月29日公布Gemini檔案製作、預覽與直接編輯功能；PDF預覽及編輯支援網頁和手機，其他列明格式只支援網頁。

其他格式包括Google Docs、Google Sheets、簡報、Markdown、TXT及程式碼。

Google表示功能向Gemini App可用地區及語言的所有用戶開放；可自行修改或選取內容要求AI調整。

行銷團隊可評估在同一對話完成初稿與修改，仍須檢查匯出後的版面及數字。

用一份非機密簡報及PDF測試修改流程，對照原始文案、表格及手機預覽。

「所有用戶」仍受Gemini App本身的地區與語言可用範圍限制；本刊未測試檔案格式保真度。
article.detail_en:
Google announced file creation, preview and direct editing in Gemini on October 29. PDF preview and editing support web and mobile; other listed formats are web-only.

Other formats include Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown, TXT and code.

Google says the capabilities are available to all users in languages where Gemini is available; users can edit directly or select content for AI refinement.

Marketing teams can assess drafting and revision in one conversation while checking exported layouts and numbers.

Test a nonconfidential deck and PDF, comparing original copy, tables and the mobile preview.

All-user access remains bounded by Gemini app availability; export fidelity has not been independently tested.
